Our story

The sign at the road is the last of it

Match Mart left the fuel brand. Most of the internet still hasn't noticed.

The corporate station finder dropped the listing and the old page it pointed to went dead. Directories that scrape those listings still file this store under a brand it walked away from, and the “website” button on Google still sends people to a page that no longer exists.

Nothing else about the place changed. Same doors, same counter, same fryer, same shelves. The only thing that left was a logo — and a customer put the store's actual character better than a brand ever did: “one of few still around that have the small town feel.”
